source: Gambia Revenue Authority, Employment Income Tax (PAYE) Brochure (https://gra.gm/download-file/8d0ccc58-d217-11ed-9b31-029254d29bb1, PDF created 18 March 2026, read 2026-11-05): annual bands 0% to D36,000, 5% to D46,000, 10% to D56,000, 15% to D66,000, 20% to D76,000, 25% above; 'No deductions are allowed', so the rate applies to total employment income. The brochure's own text says 'as at January 2018', though it shows the D36,000 threshold that law-firm and payroll summaries date from 1 January 2025 (an older GRA brochure, https://gra.gm/download-file/8d0cd78a-d217-11ed-9b31-029254d29bb1, shows D24,000, 5% to D34,000 and so on, to 25% above D64,000); the 2025 start date is from those summaries, not from a GRA notice or the Finance Act, which were not read. GRA's worked example for D50,000 a month gives D11,333.34 (the sum of lines each rounded); this pack rounds once and gives 11,333.33.
